## Summary

Collect numerical morph metadata for the next advanced enemy-panel import slice of original491b002.

```text
retained placement ratio + composed matrix
  → existing morphShapeAtRatio
  → numerical bounds / solid fill / stroke
```

Expose the existing affine multiply helper for nested field registration.

## Evidence

- **Before:** All three synthetic regressions fail: morph leaves are absent, retained ratios cannot contribute bounds, and importers cannot reuse matrix composition.
  **After:** Default/middle/end interpolation, ratio-only and matrix-only timeline moves, and nested transformed bounds pass.
- The local original-SWF probe of confirmation915 at frames2/7/12/17/22 now returns three numerical leaves per pose instead of zero or one, including authored ratios60186 and5350.
- Both existing importers ran twice and reproduced their controls69,147-byte and palette22,507-byte tables byte for byte. No generated data changes.
- Formatting, TypeScript and504 rule/parser tests (6,124 assertions) pass.
- Tool-only change: runtime rendering/contact and browser flows are unchanged. Child sprites still use existing frame1 traversal. Advanced panel metadata, artwork, controls and complete confirmation timing remain separate work; this does not establish visual or game parity. No source contours or media are committed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the previous collector. Existing generated tables are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** importers

Future imports can now include previously omitted morph leaves. Runtime asset parsing is reused unchanged.

## Summary

Collect numerical morph metadata for the next advanced enemy-panel import slice of original491b002.

```text
retained placement ratio + composed matrix
  → existing morphShapeAtRatio
  → numerical bounds / solid fill / stroke
```

Expose the existing affine multiply helper for nested field registration.

## Evidence

- **Before:** All three synthetic regressions fail: morph leaves are absent, retained ratios cannot contribute bounds, and importers cannot reuse matrix composition.
  **After:** Default/middle/end interpolation, ratio-only and matrix-only timeline moves, and nested transformed bounds pass.
- The local original-SWF probe of confirmation915 at frames2/7/12/17/22 now returns three numerical leaves per pose instead of zero or one, including authored ratios60186 and5350.
- Both existing importers ran twice and reproduced their controls69,147-byte and palette22,507-byte tables byte for byte. No generated data changes.
- Formatting, TypeScript and504 rule/parser tests (6,124 assertions) pass.
- Tool-only change: runtime rendering/contact and browser flows are unchanged. Child sprites still use existing frame1 traversal. Advanced panel metadata, artwork, controls and complete confirmation timing remain separate work; this does not establish visual or game parity. No source contours or media are committed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the previous collector. Existing generated tables are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** importers

Future imports can now include previously omitted morph leaves. Runtime asset parsing is reused unchanged.
